## Core Services
1. Popcorn Ceiling Removal: Dust-contained machine sanding using Festool Planex systems, smooth skim coating, priming, and clean ceiling repaints.
2. Interior & Exterior Painting: Walls, ceilings, millwork, cabinets, siding, and comprehensive masking/floor protection.
3. Drywall Hanging, Taping & Repair: Drywall installation, taping, mudding, texture blending, water damage repair, and seamless patch restoration.
